vow.title: Arokia
vow.body: This app is not Jesus Christ — it is only a tool that points to Him.
vow.updatedNotice: This vow has been updated — please read and accept it again.

nameMeaning.heading: Meaning of the Name
nameMeaning.body: Arokia is not only bodily health; it is a Tamil word that also recalls wholeness, healing, and well-being of life in Christ. The name is familiar to many Tamil Christians through the Arokia Matha / Vailankanni heritage; at the same time, this app is a simple tool to help all Tamil Christians — Catholic, Protestant, Pentecostal, and CSI/Anglican — return to the words of Jesus.

pillars.heading: The Four Pillars
pillars.word: To hear and read Jesus's own words as they stand in Scripture.
pillars.walk: To help people walk out what He said in daily life.
pillars.hopeFaithLove: To help people stand in hope, faith, and love through anxiety, grief, and loneliness.
pillars.integrity: To handle scripture, money, and corrections transparently and truthfully.

ecumenical.heading: An Approach for Everyone
ecumenical.body: Arokia does not raise or lower any one church tradition; its purpose is to help Catholics, Protestants, Pentecostals, CSI/Anglicans, and all Tamil Christians unite around the words of Jesus.

correctionProcess.heading: Correction Disclosure Process
correctionProcess.body: When a theological concern is submitted, it is recorded and reviewed within 7 days. If a correction is confirmed as needed, the verse or audio is corrected and the change is disclosed transparently.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: Arokia is an anonymous app used without an account, login, or identity link. Your preference settings stay on the device. If you provide an email in the theological concern form, it is used only to reply about that concern; it is not used for advertising, marketing, or linking content to your identity. Information needed for donation receipts is handled separately through Razorpay.

concern.title: Report a Theological Concern
concern.emailPlaceholder: Enter your email to receive a reply
concern.confirmationBody: Your concern has been received. It will be reviewed within 7 days.

worship.title: Sunday Worship
worship.invitation: If you like, you can quietly mark the Sundays you attended worship.
